ggxpnp_seo_title: GGx by Gran Gol — Free 3D Print & Play Football Game
ggxpnp_seo_description: GGx by Gran Gol is a free 3D Print & Play football game.
ggxpnp_title: Free Print & Play Tabletop Football Game
ggxpnp_subtitle: Print GGx for free at home and bring your favourite teams to the table.
ggxpnp_assembly_title: Easy to set up. Ready to play.
ggxpnp_assembly_text: Once printed, GGx is quick and simple to assemble. Set it up on any hard surface — a table, the floor, wherever the match happens.
ggxpnp_assembly_media_alt: GGx tabletop football stadium being assembled on a table.
ggxpnp_what_text: GGx reimagines the tradition of homemade tabletop football for the age of 3D printing. Print the game at home, choose your teams and bring football to the table.
ggxpnp_pitch_media_alt: A GGx tabletop football match set up on a table at home.
ggxpnp_why_text: GGx was made to create simple moments away from screens. Moments to play face to face, talk, compete, laugh and simply spend quality time together.
ggxpnp_moments_media_alt: A GGx player taking a shot towards the goal during a tabletop football match.
ggxpnp_print_text: Download GGx for free on MakerWorld, print the game at home and get ready for kick-off.
ggxpnp_grangol_title: GGx is part of Gran Gol
ggxpnp_grangol_text: GGx brings a small piece of Gran Gol into the physical world. Gran Gol is a football game currently in development. There’s more to these players, teams and matches than GGx reveals.
ggxpnp_teams_text: Print the team you love, the team you love to hate... or both. Then bring them to your home stadium and make some football memories.
ggxpnp_teams_media_alt: A selection of GGx football teams in different colours and kits.
